knowledge:
- key_parameters: n_features=controls the number of features selected in selectFeatures (default is 500) ;; cluster_col=specifies the column in colData of the reference to identify clusters in indexCluster (default is cell_type1) ;; threshold=similarity threshold in scmapCell2Cluster for assigning a cell to a reference cluster (default is 0.5)
- alternatives: None mentioned in the documentation.
- when_to_use: When comparing scRNA-seq datasets of similar biological origin collected by different labs, or projecting cells from a new sample onto a large reference (like the Human Cell Atlas) to characterize composition differences or detect new cell-types.
- pitfalls: scmap-cell contains a k-means step which makes it stochastic, so set.seed() must be used for reproducibility ;; The input SingleCellExperiment must not contain duplicate feature names ;; Cell type information must be stored in the cell_type1 column of the colData slot of the reference SingleCellExperiment object (or specified via cluster_col) ;; If the counts() slot is missing, dropouts are calculated using the logcounts() slot, which triggers a warning.

workflows.name: scmap_cluster
workflows.intent: Project query single-cell RNA-seq data onto reference cell-type clusters to assign cell-type labels.
input: ann (data frame containing cell type annotations)
workflows.stages: 1. Create SingleCellExperiment object and preprocess ;; 2. Feature selection using selectFeatures ;; 3. Reference indexing using indexCluster ;; 4. Projection using scmapCluster ;; 5. Visualization using getSankey
workflows.code:
sce <- SingleCellExperiment(assays = list(normcounts = as.matrix(yan)), colData = ann)
logcounts(sce) <- log2(normcounts(sce) + 1)
rowData(sce)$feature_symbol <- rownames(sce)
sce <- sce[!duplicated(rownames(sce)), ]
sce <- selectFeatures(sce, suppress_plot = FALSE)
sce <- indexCluster(sce)
scmapCluster_results <- scmapCluster(
  projection = sce, 
  index_list = list(
    yan = metadata(sce)$scmap_cluster_index
  )
)
plot(
  getSankey(
    colData(sce)$cell_type1,
    scmapCluster_results$scmap_cluster_labs[,'yan'],
    plot_height = 400
  )
)

workflows.name: scmap_cell
workflows.intent: Project query single-cell RNA-seq data onto individual reference cells and optionally annotate them using reference cluster labels.
input: ann (data frame containing cell type annotations)
workflows.stages: 1. Create SingleCellExperiment object and preprocess ;; 2. Feature selection using selectFeatures ;; 3. Reference cell indexing using indexCell ;; 4. Projection using scmapCell ;; 5. Cluster annotation using scmapCell2Cluster ;; 6. Visualization using getSankey
workflows.code:
sce <- SingleCellExperiment(assays = list(normcounts = as.matrix(yan)), colData = ann)
logcounts(sce) <- log2(normcounts(sce) + 1)
rowData(sce)$feature_symbol <- rownames(sce)
sce <- sce[!duplicated(rownames(sce)), ]
sce <- selectFeatures(sce, suppress_plot = FALSE)
set.seed(1)
sce <- indexCell(sce)
scmapCell_results <- scmapCell(
  sce, 
  list(
    yan = metadata(sce)$scmap_cell_index
  )
)
scmapCell_clusters <- scmapCell2Cluster(
  scmapCell_results, 
  list(
    as.character(colData(sce)$cell_type1)
  )
)
plot(
  getSankey(
    colData(sce)$cell_type1,
    scmapCell_clusters$scmap_cluster_labs[,"yan"],
    plot_height = 400
  )
)
